name: Readarr
description: Readarr compares the update package SHA-256 with the hash in its package metadata and rejects a mismatch. This is a source-level integrity observation; independent publisher authentication, automatic-update policy and historical release behavior are not certified here.
limitations: The separately pinned retrieved checkout is not proof of the original study release.
This review supports the package checksum control, not a complete assessment of metadata authentication or automatic-update settings.
